headline: Liquor and entertainment license requests for holiday events at Charlotte Forten Park, plus other business license applications.
summary: Requests include one day liquor licenses for Charlotte Forten Park and a common victualler license on Derby Street. Other items cover a liquor license transfer on Blaney Street and two fortunetelling license requests.
items: One day liquor licenses at Charlotte Forten Park for November 27th thru November 29th, December 11th thru December 13th, and December 31st, applicant Salem Main Streets
Entertainment license for Holiday Happenings programming at Charlotte Forten Park, November 27, 2026 thru December 31, 2026, applicant Salem Main Streets
Entertainment license at 311 Derby Street for The Goat Salem, covering eight kinds of entertainment, including live music and line dancing
Change of officers, directors, LLC managers, and manager for Thai Hut, Inc., doing business as Thai Place, at 2 East India Square; new manager Yuvapan Nualpring
Common victualler license at 206 Derby Street, applicant Tran An Hospitality, doing business as Tran AN
Transfer of a seasonal all alcoholic liquor license at 10 Blaney Street from Hornblower Cruises and Events Inc. to Boston Harbor Cruises LLC, doing business as The Landing at Salem Ferry
Change of category and classification for Amazing Pizza LLC at 62 Wharf Street, from a seasonal all alcoholic beverages license to an annual license for wine, malt beverages, and cordials
One day liquor license at 385 Essex Street on December 11, 2026, from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM, applicant Salem Education Foundation, 100 people
One day liquor license at the House of Seven Gables, 115 Derby Street, on December 4, 2026, from 6:15 PM to 8:45 PM, applicant Historic Salem, Inc., 95 people
Store fortunetelling renewal at 131 Essex Street, applicant The Sea Wych Salem, owner Theresa Needham
Individual fortunetelling license at 11 Cypress Street, applicant Desiree Anne Dudonnet-Olsen
